commits.author: dlwh
commits.message:
[TaskCompendium] Define single-result tasks and verifier contracts (#9646)

Define TaskSpec schema 0.20 for one final result, with environment
requirements, named tool-provider contracts, inline resources grouped by
visibility, and a private verifier for that result. Resource bytes live
in the spec; declarations carry permissions and optional modification
times. Shared file references are deferred until a TaskSet contract
defines their location and loading. The final_tools list defines
functions available to the final assistant turn; submission conventions
set required-call and call-count limits.

Exact, numeric, multiple-choice and predicted-action verifier contracts
and pure scoring live in verifyit. Conversion pipelines choose a
contract for the private verifier slot. TaskCompendium extracts
submission evidence for verifier scoring. Direct-chat export and Harbor
Trial launch reject unmet file, runtime and tool-provider requirements
before creating artifacts or sending model requests. Dataset processing
and storage layout belong to conversion pipelines. Resource
materialization and additional runtimes remain unimplemented in this
foundation.

This schema is the foundation for the grading changes in #9608 and the
Harbor Docker bridge in #9556, and supersedes #9635.

commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
[inference] Add two-model chat comparison (#9712)

Add a Compare tab to the Marin serve dashboard. It sends each prompt to
the current model and a second Marin serve dashboard URL, then shows
both replies side by side. Each completed turn can be marked left,
right, tie, or both bad. Paired transcripts and selections persist in
browser localStorage.

The second URL must share the current page's origin so browser requests
can reach both endpoints through the Iris controller proxy. It can
contain a capability token, so the browser does not save the URL.
Reenter it after a reload to continue sending prompts to the saved pair.

---------

Co-authored-by: William Held <9847335+Helw150@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.author: Helw150
commits.message:
[evaldash] Avoid loading serving snapshots during ingestion (#9710)

Run EvalDash ingestion directly against PostgreSQL without loading or
reloading the web server's full catalog snapshot. Read and materialize
catalog rows for at most 128 run IDs at a time, preserving one
transaction per prefix. Update stored prefix priority and membership
only during ingestion, so constructing a status reader does not change
which sources supply the catalog.

The production ingestion job repeatedly exceeds its 1 GiB memory limit,
preventing new S3 results from reaching the dashboard. These changes
remove unnecessary full-catalog allocations; object checks still retain
all parsed records checked in each prefix. Production peak memory has
not been measured, and the job's memory allocation is unchanged.
[Incident details](https://marina.oa.dev/echo/wiki/582).
